note: Small private campground at W16270 County Road D, about 8.5 miles east of Chetek (Rusk County), between the Chetek and Island Chain of Lakes but not on the water. Mostly seasonal: 3 of its 27 sites are sold by the night (sites 12, 13 and 15). Hiking trails, mini golf and park-model rentals. A 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
